facts.fact: A pilot census was launched on 1 Aug 2026 in Magude district (177 enumeration areas, 177 enumerators, 38 controllers, about USD 430,000) ahead of the fifth general census of 2027; World Bank initial financing of USD 12.7m and a USD 68m gap of USD 110m were reported.
INE's estimate cites the last census in 2017 as having recorded just over 26 million inhabitants; no enumeration date is given.
